findings.message: 16 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 11759px of nothing between: "Excuse me!"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 4 lines at 390px: "Rehearse ordinary moments before a trip:…" → 7 lines at 24px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
